texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: How Northwind sounds
texts.text: How Northwind sounds

texts.label: text
texts.orig: We're a residential trades business. Most of our customers contact us because something has gone wrong in their home - sometimes mildly annoying, sometimes genuinely stressful. Our tone needs to match that. We sound like a competent neighbour, not a call centre.
texts.text: We're a residential trades business. Most of our customers contact us because something has gone wrong in their home - sometimes mildly annoying, sometimes genuinely stressful. Our tone needs to match that. We sound like a competent neighbour, not a call centre.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Three rules of voice:
texts.text: Three rules of voice:

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Plain, not formal. We say 'we'll send someone out', not 'we will dispatch a service representative'.
texts.text: Plain, not formal. We say 'we'll send someone out', not 'we will dispatch a service representative'.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Specific, not generic. Reference what the customer actually said. Don't open with 'Thank you for contacting Northwind'.
texts.text: Specific, not generic. Reference what the customer actually said. Don't open with 'Thank you for contacting Northwind'.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Honest, not performative. If we can't help, say so plainly. Don't apologise four times.
texts.text: Honest, not performative. If we can't help, say so plainly. Don't apologise four times.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Length
texts.text: Length

texts.label: text
texts.orig: First-response replies should be 2-4 sentences . Anything longer feels like a corporate form letter. The goal is to acknowledge, set an expectation, and end. The tradesperson or team lead handles detail when they call back.
texts.text: First-response replies should be 2-4 sentences . Anything longer feels like a corporate form letter. The goal is to acknowledge, set an expectation, and end. The tradesperson or team lead handles detail when they call back.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Greetings & sign-offs
texts.text: Greetings & sign-offs

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Open with the customer's first name if we have it. If not, no greeting at all - go straight in.
texts.text: Open with the customer's first name if we have it. If not, no greeting at all - go straight in.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Sign off with 'The Northwind team' for first responses. Individual names are reserved for follow-ups from a named tradesperson.
texts.text: Sign off with 'The Northwind team' for first responses. Individual names are reserved for follow-ups from a named tradesperson.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Never use 'Dear', 'Kind regards', or 'Yours sincerely'. They're too formal for us.
texts.text: Never use 'Dear', 'Kind regards', or 'Yours sincerely'. They're too formal for us.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Words and phrases to avoid
texts.text: Words and phrases to avoid

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Hard rules
texts.text: Hard rules

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Never quote a price unless the catalogue lists it as fixed .
texts.text: Never quote a price unless the catalogue lists it as fixed .

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Never name a specific tradesperson in a first response.
texts.text: Never name a specific tradesperson in a first response.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Never promise an exact time - give a window or an SLA.
texts.text: Never promise an exact time - give a window or an SLA.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Never use exclamation marks. We're warm, not enthusiastic.
texts.text: Never use exclamation marks. We're warm, not enthusiastic.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Never use emoji.
texts.text: Never use emoji.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: When the customer is upset
texts.text: When the customer is upset

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Acknowledge it directly in the first sentence. Don't bury it under pleasantries. A complaint reply should never read like a booking reply with the word 'sorry' added.
texts.text: Acknowledge it directly in the first sentence. Don't bury it under pleasantries. A complaint reply should never read like a booking reply with the word 'sorry' added.
